title: Scoped negative: exact PR589 A-triple transport census (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

Adds an exact, reproducible finite census for the seed-selected simultaneous A-operation triple `(927, 928, 930)` in the selected PR589 `v=111`, `R=439` word. The three operations write register 325 at frame 282 from sources 256, 442 and 392.

All `7 × 6 × 5 = 210` legal slot/frame assignments are classified: 46 fail full register-chain nesting, 100 valid assignments preserve the baseline paid profile, and 64 valid assignments yield the same strictly higher-cost profile. There are no improvements or unresolved cases. This is a scoped negative result; it claims no new `κ` or supplier admission.

## Reproduction

From the repository root (verified with CPython 3.14.7):

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit589-shared-register-triple-seed05/verify.py
```

Expected output:

```text
PASS_PR589_A_TRIPLE_TRANSPORT seed=5 ops=927,928,930 assignments=210 valid=164 ties=100 losses=64 incompatible=46 controls=3 no_new_kappa
```

The package pins base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`, the selected PR589 word and bit cost, and PR1345 atlas head `b54a856aa79857d91cd5d65f8f7144e26c8c084f`. The PR1345 transport atlas is credited and vendored under its repository license. PR #1382 is a distinct A/B cross-section pair census.

The census concerns this one triple only. Other triples, larger move sets, structural changes, and alternate suppliers remain outside its conclusion; the inherited compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, and analytic assumptions remain. Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for task selection, enumeration, verification, and writing. No independent human review or subagents are claimed.
